questions.stem: My father _____ to Beijing twice. He went there last month for a business trip.
questions.explanation: 选B。has been to表示"曾经去过某地（已经回来）"，has gone to表示"去了某地（还没回来）"。根据后句"He went there last month"可知父亲已经回来，且twice表示经历，用现在完成时。went是一般过去时，只表示过去动作，不强调对现在的影响（去过两次的经历）。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The boy _____ is wearing a red jacket is my best friend. He helped me with my math yesterday.
questions.explanation: 选B。先行词是the boy（人），且在定语从句中作主语，用who。which用于先行词是物；whom用于先行词是人但作宾语；whose表示"谁的"，作定语。口诀：人主who，人宾whom，人物whose，物which。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These old buildings _____ by the government last year to make room for a new park.
questions.explanation: 选B。last year是一般过去时标志，且建筑物是"被拆除"，用一般过去时的被动语态was/were+过去分词。buildings是复数，用were。A是一般现在时被动；C、D是主动语态。解题关键：找时间标志词（last year）+ 判断主被动关系。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: I _____ the book for two weeks, but I _____ it yet because it's quite difficult.
questions.explanation: 选B。第一空：for two weeks是时间段，要求用延续性动词，borrow（借）是瞬间动词，不能与时间段连用，需换成keep（保存/借阅）；第二空：yet是现在完成时标志词（用于否定句和疑问句），表示"还/尚未"。A错在borrow不能接时间段；C、D错在yet要求搭配现在完成时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The doctor told Tom to reduce his sugar intake. He advised him to eat less candy, soda, and desserts to stay healthy. The word "reduce" probably means _____.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据上下文线索"eat less"（少吃）可知，reduce的意思是"减少"，与decrease同义。increase是增加（反义），keep是保持，change是改变。解题技巧：通过解释性的同义线索（eat less）或反义线索猜测词义。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We need to _____ the meeting until next Friday because the manager is sick today.
questions.explanation: 选A。put off表示"推迟"；put on表示"穿上/上演"；put up表示"张贴/搭建"；put away表示"收起来/放好"。根据语境"经理生病了"可知需要"推迟"会议。解题技巧：put短语是中考高频考点，记住核心含义：off（离开/推迟）、on（穿上/上演）、up（向上/张贴）、away（离开/收起）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It is _____ to talk loudly in the library. Everyone should keep quiet there.
questions.explanation: 选D。根据后句"Everyone should keep quiet"（应该保持安静）可知，大声说话是"不礼貌的"。im-是否定前缀，impolite=not polite。possible（可能的）和impossible（不可能的）不符合语境逻辑。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 选A。instead放在句末表示"相反/取而代之"，符合语境：过去买瓶装水，现在带可重复使用的水瓶"代替"。either用于否定句末"也"；too用于肯定句末"也"；also用于句中。解题关键：根据上下文逻辑关系（转折/替代）选择。

questions.group_passage: My name is Lily. I am a middle school student who cares deeply about the environment. Last year, I decided to change my lifestyle to reduce waste. At first, it was not easy. My friends were surprised by my changes. They asked me why I was doing this. I explained that small actions can make a big (9) _____ to our planet. Some of them even joined me. Every weekend, we (10) _____ together to clean up the local park. It makes us feel proud to see the park become cleaner. I believe that if everyone takes responsibility, we (11) _____ a better world in the future. This lifestyle change has not only helped the environment but also taught me to be more (12) _____ about my choices.

questions.explanation: 选A。make a difference是固定搭配，意为"有影响/起作用"。make a decision（做决定）、make a difficulty（制造困难）、make a direction（指明方向）都不是固定搭配。根据语境"小行动能对地球产生大影响"，选difference。

questions.stem: What was the writer responsible for in the group?
questions.explanation: 选B。细节理解题。根据文章第三段"I was responsible for writing the explanation cards"可知，作者负责写说明卡片。A是Tom负责的（Tom...designed the structure），C是Lisa负责的（Lisa, tested the model），D是大家一起做的（we...collected materials）。解题技巧：细节题要准确定位原文，注意人名与职责的对应关系。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school held an annual science fair that attracted great attention from both students and teachers. Each class was asked to create an innovative project focused on environmental protection and sustainable living. After several discussions, my group of four classmates decided to make a working model demonstrating how to recycle and reuse greywater (生活废水) in daily life.

We spent two intense weeks preparing for the exhibition. First, we conducted thorough research online about modern water recycling systems and filtration methods. Then, we enthusiastically collected recyclable materials from our homes and neighborhoods, such as plastic bottles, old PVC pipes, and discarded filters. Our team leader, Tom, who has a talent for engineering, carefully designed the structure and assembly process. I was responsible for writing clear explanation cards and preparing the presentation script. Meanwhile, another teammate, Lisa, repeatedly tested the model to ensure it operated smoothly without leaks.

On the day of the fair, the gymnasium was packed with curious visitors. Many students and teachers stopped by our booth, asking detailed questions about how the filtration system functioned and its practical applications in households. We patiently explained that the recycled water could be safely used to water garden plants or flush toilets, significantly reducing water waste. To our absolute delight and surprise, our eco-friendly project won the first prize among twenty competing teams! The judges praised our idea as being both scientifically sound and practically applicable to daily life.

This rewarding experience taught me that science is not merely about abstract theories confined within textbooks. Rather, it is about collaboratively solving real-world problems through creative teamwork and persistent innovation. I sincerely hope more students will participate in such hands-on activities to discover the true joy and value of scientific exploration.

questions.stem: What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. The team didn't prepare well for the fair
B. Only Tom worked hard on the project
C. The project was practical and creative
D. They didn't win any prize at the fair
questions.explanation: 选C。推理判断题。根据第三段"The judges praised our idea as being both scientifically sound and practically applicable"可知，这个项目既科学又实用，可推断出它实用且有创意。A与文中"spent two intense weeks preparing"矛盾；B与文中大家分工合作（Tom设计、作者写卡片、Lisa测试）矛盾；D与"won the first prize"矛盾。解题技巧：推理题要基于原文信息进行合理推断，不能选与原文矛盾的选项。

questions.explanation: 选B。根据后句"First, create a weekly schedule..."（首先，制定每周时间表）可知，此处需要总起句，提出"设定明确的优先事项和时间表"，且B选项的"First of all"与后文的"First"呼应。这是总分结构中的主题句。

questions.group_passage:
Many middle school students struggle to balance their academic responsibilities with personal hobbies. However, with proper planning, it is possible to enjoy both study and leisure time. Here are some practical tips.

(17) _____ First, create a weekly schedule that includes specific time slots for studying and for hobbies. This helps ensure that neither is neglected. Be realistic about how much time you need for homework.

(18) _____ Use hobbies as rewards after completing study tasks. For example, promise yourself thirty minutes of basketball practice after finishing math homework. This motivates you to work efficiently.

(19) _____ Additionally, choose hobbies that complement your studies. If you enjoy photography, you can practice writing skills by keeping a photo journal. If you like music, listen to English songs to improve your language skills.

(20) _____ Remember that balance is key. Too much studying leads to burnout, while too much hobby time affects grades. Find the rhythm that works best for you and adjust when necessary.
